import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    coord = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            coord[i][j] = int(next(it))
    bad = [False]*n
    count = n
    for i in range(n):
        found = False
        for j in range(n):
            if j == i:
                continue
            for k in range(n):
                if k == i or k == j:
                    continue
                prod = 0
                for m in range(5):
                    a = coord[j][m] - coord[i][m]
                    b = coord[k][m] - coord[i][m]
                    prod += a * b
                if prod > 0:
                    found = True
                    bad[i] = True
                    count -= 1
                    break
            if found:
                break
    print(count)
    for i in range(n):
        if not bad[i]:
            print(i + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
